name: Apartment-Block Geopolitician
description: A suspicious everyday expert who can explain every border from the apartment entrance.

comebacks.weak: Pass the popcorn. Your argument needs salt.
comebacks.medium: I called it a bad joke. You called yours a foreign policy.
comebacks.strong: I stayed home for the debate. Somehow your facts still failed to turn up.

editorialReview.notes: Original fictional comebacks transform debate-spectator popcorn bravado and its later bad-joke explanation into domestic geopolitical overconfidence. Private research records sources; no attribution or quotation ships.
